title: The 13 Software Engineering Laws
summary: Covers 13 named laws (Hyrum's Law, Conway's Law, Brooks' Law, etc.) with implications for estimation, team structure, and feature scope.
when-to-read: Read when facing decisions about project estimation, team structure, scope creep, or performance metrics and want a named principle to reason from. Do not read for tactical implementation advice on a specific practice — these are organizational/behavioral laws, not step-by-step techniques.
